title: Deciding under time pressure

D0.outcome: Explains that time shortage changes the error profile: fewer checks of the opponent's reply and more reliance on the first idea.

D1.outcome: Solves a set at half the normal time and states which step of the loop he skipped.

D2.outcome: Keeps the safety scan under time pressure with at least 80 percent of his untimed accuracy.

D3.outcome: In low-time positions, chooses simple robust moves and avoids committing to long lines.

sources: docs/council-synthesis.md CD-14, Round 14 (error taxonomy under time)
conditions: The learner has a reliable untimed baseline for the same positions.
contrasts: A long calculation started with little time left.
Dropping the safety scan under pressure.
A position with only one legal move.
